claims.value: Side A: Lamarque reports forming 1,500 men in the La Salud position during the July 9 retreat.
claims.rationale: Own-side report reprinted by Suchet; before Beurmann’s reinforcement, not a total for all phases. English rendering (ours): "I formed my fifteen hundred men, determined to fight whatever appeared."

claims.value: Side B: Lamarque says a prisoner reported 8,000–9,000 men at the position, including brigades under Manso, Fleires, Villamil and a reserve under d’Eroles.
claims.rationale: Prisoner hearsay mediated by the opponent’s interested report; not a Spanish own-side return or reconciled with Bodart 7,000. English rendering (ours): "A prisoner told me the three brigades, cavalry and d’Eroles’s reserve—eight to nine thousand men—were on this point."
